Application Data.NAME: Greenwood Plaza Shopping Center
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Greenwood Plaza Shopping Center is a multi-tenant retail facility located in Greenwood, Colorado, featuring a diverse mix of tenants including professional offices, boutique retail stores, and service-oriented businesses. The shopping center comprises approximately 75,000 square feet of leasable space and includes essential amenities such as ample parking, well-maintained landscaping, and updated safety features including fire suppression systems and security cameras. The property has a strong focus on tenant retention and community engagement, hosting regular events that promote local businesses. With a clean claims history and diligent risk management practices in place, the center prioritizes tenant safety and satisfaction, ensuring a favorable environment for both shoppers and retailers.
